prompt:
Paint one game inventory icon in Heavenprint: hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken, directional brush
strokes, selective dry-brush scumbling and restrained hatching where a contour or crease needs it, charcoal shadows,
warm ivory accents on the focal edges, quiet low-detail areas. Not line art, not flat ink, not a photograph, not a 3D
render, no airbrushed gloss and no uniform digital sharpness. One single object, three-quarter view, lit from one
side (upper left), with a short soft painted shading on its own underside only: no ground, no cast shadow, no scene.
Fully transparent background. Square canvas, 1024 x 1024 PNG with alpha; the object fills about 80% of the canvas
(keep it inside the central 80 to 85%, about 100 px of clear margin on every side). No text, no letters, no numbers,
no logos, no maker marks, no borders, no frame, no hands and no figures. Everything is invented: never a recognisable
real-world make, model or emblem. The silhouette must be bold and instantly readable first: the icon is shown at 64 px
in a shop grid and at 32 px in a backpack row, so keep detail concentrated on one or two focal edges and make the
shape unmistakable when shrunk. Colour: metal is painted in the palette's neutrals (charcoal, steel grey, warm ivory
highlights); the faction's signature colour is the single accent (given in each prompt). Rarity is not shown by a
coloured border (the UI adds that): standard finish only, with honest wear. Scale within a family stays consistent:
every object in one family fills the frame by the same rule, given in its family paragraph.

FAMILY: Diagonal like the rifles, about 80% of the canvas width (the sawn-off is a one-hand pistol shape at pistol size). Shape language: fat muzzles, tube magazines or double barrels; Lumeri lancet arches and spire sights; Brigade boxy plates and crests; frontier walnut and brass; the sawn-off a rough cut with tape.

SUBJECT: Sawn-off. A single fictional game inventory prop. VISUAL DESIGN: a short cut-down double barrel with a bare hacksaw edge, and a stock cut down to a pistol grip with tape on it. **Materials and accent:** bare steel at the cut, scuffed dark steel, wrapped grip; accent: a strip of faded red tape. **At 32 px:** Against the coach gun: no stock, tiny, with a taped pistol grip; the coach gun has a full stock.

Match the attached Heavenprint PAINTED materials, not the top-down camera of object references. Portrait reference is brushwork only: no person or scene. Strong designed silhouette, clear mechanical construction, directional paint, restrained localized wear. Avoid identical random scratches on every surface. One separate item icon, no sheet or collage, no text. Preserve empty transparency all around.
User direction: make the weapons cooler with confident, distinctive silhouette and faction-specific engineered details, tasteful sculpted housings and deliberate negative space. Still standard issued gear, not ornate rarity variants. Avoid generic real-world firearms or arbitrary spikes; use this item’s specified signature. For any firearm muzzle RIGHT, gently rising upper-right, stock or grip LEFT.
The last reference is the existing outline silhouette for this exact item; keep its identifying shape, but render a solid painted physical object, not outline art.
